description:
Revokes the current player session on the server, or all of that player's sessions when explicitly requested.
Use when: the player explicitly chooses logout, or chooses to revoke all sessions on their devices.
Not for: only clearing an SDK cache or logging out a developer dashboard account. Use horizon_signin_* for a future login.
Side effects: revokes current access and refresh family, or all user sessions if allSessions=true. Clear corresponding local credentials after confirmed success; SDK SignOut alone only clears local state. It does not revoke the anonymous recovery credential.
Returns: empty HTTP 204 represented as null. allSessions omitted/false affects only the current session.
Errors: 401 when the supplied access token is missing/invalid/expired. An error does not prove remote revocation; require signin if access has expired. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

allSessions.description: Revoke all sessions for this user only when explicitly requested; omitted/false revokes the current session only

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from signup, signin or refresh-session, passed as sessionToken (max 256 characters)

name: horizon_signout
title: Sign Out Player
